classes.name: TweenService
classes.doc: Makes tweens: animations of instance properties over time.

methods.name: Create
methods.doc: A new tween that animates the named properties of the instance to the given goal values. Numbers, booleans, Vector3, Vector2, CFrame, Color3, UDim, UDim2, Rect and NumberRange properties can be tweened; any other type raises RE9352.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.doc: The eased value of alpha (clamped to 0..1) for this style and direction.

classes.name: TweenBase
classes.doc: What every tween can do: play, pause and cancel, with its playback state.

properties.name: PlaybackState
properties.doc: Where the tween is: Begin, Delayed, Playing, Paused, Completed or Cancelled.

methods.name: Play
methods.doc: Starts the tween from the current property values, or resumes it when paused. Cancels other running tweens of the same instance that animate one of the same properties.

methods.name: Pause
methods.doc: Stops the tween where it is; Play resumes it.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.doc: Stops the tween where it is and fires Completed with Cancelled; the next Play starts over.

events.name: Completed
events.doc: Fires when the tween finishes (Completed) or is cancelled (Cancelled).

classes.name: Tween
classes.doc: A property animation made by TweenService:Create.

properties.name: Instance
properties.doc: The instance whose properties the tween animates.

properties.name: TweenInfo
properties.doc: Not readable here: keep the TweenInfo you passed to Create. Raises RE9001.

classes.name: GuiBase2d
classes.doc: What every 2D UI object has: its laid-out position and size in pixels.

properties.name: AbsolutePosition
properties.doc: The top-left corner in screen pixels, written by the layout each frame.

properties.name: AbsoluteSize
properties.doc: The size in screen pixels, written by the layout each frame.

properties.name: AbsoluteRotation
properties.doc: The rotation in degrees including the ancestors', written by the layout each frame.

classes.name: LayerCollector
classes.doc: A root of 2D UI: its descendants are drawn while it is enabled.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false, nothing under it is drawn and it takes no input.

properties.name: ResetOnSpawn
properties.doc: When true, the copy in PlayerGui is replaced each time the character spawns.

properties.name: ZIndexBehavior
properties.doc: Sibling: children draw above their parent and ZIndex orders siblings. Global: ZIndex orders every element under the root.

classes.name: ScreenGui
classes.doc: UI drawn over the 3D view, filling the screen.

properties.name: DisplayOrder
properties.doc: Drawing order among screen UIs: higher draws on top.

properties.name: IgnoreGuiInset
properties.doc: When true, the UI also covers the top bar inset; otherwise it starts below it.

properties.name: ScreenInsets
properties.note: None draws under the top bar like IgnoreGuiInset; the other insets all start below the top bar (no device notches or side insets).
properties.doc: Which screen insets the UI keeps clear of.

properties.name: ClipToDeviceSafeArea
properties.note: Stored; the window has no unsafe area to clip.
properties.doc: When true, the UI is clipped to the device's safe area.

classes.name: BillboardGui
classes.doc: UI drawn at a 3D position, facing the camera.

properties.name: Adornee
properties.doc: The part or attachment it is drawn at; when empty, its parent is used.

properties.name: Size
properties.doc: The size: the scale parts are studs (so it shrinks with distance) and the offset parts are pixels.

properties.name: SizeOffset
properties.doc: A shift of the drawn rectangle as a fraction of its size.

properties.name: StudsOffset
properties.doc: An offset in studs along the camera's right, up and back axes.

properties.name: StudsOffsetWorldSpace
properties.doc: An offset in studs in world space.

properties.name: ExtentsOffset
properties.doc: Stored only.

properties.name: MaxDistance
properties.doc: Studs from the camera beyond which it is not drawn.

properties.name: AlwaysOnTop
properties.note: Billboards always draw over the 3D view: there is no depth test against parts.
properties.doc: When true, it draws over the 3D view.

properties.name: LightInfluence
properties.doc: How much scene lighting darkens it.

properties.name: Brightness
properties.doc: Stored only.

properties.name: ClipsDescendants
properties.doc: When true, descendants are cut at its rectangle.

properties.name: Active
properties.doc: When true, it takes mouse input like a ScreenGui's elements.

classes.name: SurfaceGui
classes.note: Not drawn: SurfaceGui is a non-goal in M2.
classes.doc: UI drawn on a part's face.

classes.name: GuiObject
classes.doc: What every drawn 2D element has: position, size, background and visibility.

properties.name: Position
properties.doc: Where the element sits in its parent: a fraction of the parent's size plus pixels, for the point named by AnchorPoint.

properties.name: Size
properties.doc: The element's size: a fraction of the parent's size plus pixels.

properties.name: AnchorPoint
properties.doc: The point of the element that Position places, as a fraction of its size: (0, 0) is the top left, (0.5, 0.5) the centre.

properties.name: Rotation
properties.doc: Clockwise rotation in degrees about the element's centre; descendants turn with it. Layout and AbsolutePosition ignore it.

properties.name: ZIndex
properties.doc: Drawing order among siblings (or among all elements with ZIndexBehavior Global): higher draws on top.

properties.name: LayoutOrder
properties.doc: Order under a list or grid layout whose SortOrder is LayoutOrder; ties keep child order.

properties.name: Visible
properties.doc: When false, the element and its descendants are not drawn and take no input.

properties.name: ClipsDescendants
properties.doc: When true, descendants are cut at the element's rectangle. Not applied while the element or an ancestor is rotated.

properties.name: AutomaticSize
properties.doc: Grows the element on X, Y or both to fit its children and text; Size is the minimum.

properties.name: BackgroundColor3
properties.doc: The background fill colour.

properties.name: BackgroundTransparency
properties.doc: How see-through the background is; 1 draws none.

properties.name: BorderColor3
properties.doc: The colour of the border.

properties.name: BorderSizePixel
properties.doc: The border's width in pixels, drawn outside the rectangle; 0 draws none.

properties.name: BorderMode
properties.doc: Where the border sits.

properties.name: Active
properties.doc: When true, the element sinks mouse input so elements behind it do not get it.

properties.name: Interactable
properties.doc: When false, the element and its descendants take no input.

properties.name: Selectable
properties.doc: Whether gamepad selection can land on the element (buttons are selectable by default).

properties.name: SelectionOrder
properties.note: Stored only: selection moves by position.
properties.doc: Stored only.

events.name: MouseEnter
events.doc: Fires when the mouse moves onto the element, with its screen position.

events.name: MouseLeave
events.doc: Fires when the mouse moves off the element.

events.name: MouseMoved
events.doc: Fires when the mouse moves over the element.

classes.name: Frame
classes.doc: A rectangle that holds other elements.

classes.name: TextLabel
classes.doc: A rectangle with text.

properties.name: Text
properties.doc: The text shown.

properties.name: TextColor3
properties.doc: The colour of the text.

properties.name: TextTransparency
properties.doc: How see-through the text is, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

properties.name: TextSize
properties.doc: The text height in pixels.

properties.name: TextScaled
properties.doc: When true, the text is sized to the largest that fits the element (up to 100 pixels), wrapping as needed; TextSize is ignored.

properties.name: TextWrapped
properties.doc: When true, lines break at the element's width.

properties.name: TextTruncate
properties.doc: AtEnd cuts text that does not fit and ends it with an ellipsis.

properties.name: TextXAlignment
properties.doc: Horizontal placement of the text: Left, Center or Right.

properties.name: TextYAlignment
properties.doc: Vertical placement of the text: Top, Center or Bottom.

properties.name: Font
properties.doc: The legacy font name; setting it sets FontFace to that font's family and weight. Fonts are drawn with bundled open-licence substitutes.

properties.name: FontFace
properties.doc: The font family, weight and style. Families map to bundled open-licence substitutes; an unknown family uses the default one.

properties.name: LineHeight
properties.doc: Line spacing as a multiple of the font's line height.

properties.name: RichText
properties.note: Only the bold and font colour tags; other tags are drawn as text.
properties.doc: When true, … makes text bold and … (or rgb(r,g,b)) colours it.

properties.name: TextStrokeColor3
properties.doc: The colour of the outline drawn around the text.

properties.name: TextStrokeTransparency
properties.doc: How see-through the text outline is; 1 draws none.

properties.name: TextBounds
properties.doc: The size in pixels of the laid-out text, written each frame.

properties.name: TextFits
properties.doc: False when the text does not fit the element, written each frame.

classes.name: GuiButton
classes.doc: What every button has: click events and the hover look.

properties.name: AutoButtonColor
properties.doc: When true, the background darkens while the mouse is over the button or pressing it.

properties.name: Modal
properties.note: Stored only: the mouse is never locked.
properties.doc: Stored only.

properties.name: Selected
properties.doc: A flag scripts may use; it does not change the look.

properties.name: Selectable
properties.doc: Whether gamepad selection can land on the button.

events.name: Activated
events.doc: Fires when the button is clicked, or activated while it is GuiService.SelectedObject.

events.name: MouseButton1Click
events.doc: Fires when the left button is pressed and released over the button.

events.name: MouseButton1Down
events.doc: Fires when the left button is pressed over the button.

events.name: MouseButton1Up
events.doc: Fires when the left button is released over the button.

events.name: MouseButton2Click
events.doc: Fires when the right button is pressed and released over the button.

events.name: MouseButton2Down
events.doc: Fires when the right button is pressed over the button.

events.name: MouseButton2Up
events.doc: Fires when the right button is released over the button.

properties.name: ClearTextOnFocus

properties.name: MultiLine

properties.name: TextEditable

properties.name: CursorPosition
properties.note: Typing always moves the cursor to the end, and the caret is drawn there; a script's write is kept until the next keystroke.
properties.doc: Where the cursor is (1 is before the first character), -1 when not focused.

methods.name: ReleaseFocus
methods.doc: Takes the focus away, firing FocusLost with submitted (false by default).

methods.name: IsFocused
methods.doc: True while the box has keyboard focus.

events.name: Focused
events.doc: Fires when the box gains focus.

events.name: FocusLost
events.doc: Fires when the box loses focus, with whether Enter ended the edit.

classes.name: ScrollingFrame
classes.doc: A frame whose children sit on a canvas that scrolls.

properties.name: CanvasSize
properties.doc: The canvas size: a fraction of the frame's size plus pixels.

properties.name: CanvasPosition
properties.doc: The canvas point shown at the frame's top-left corner, in pixels; kept inside the canvas.

properties.name: AutomaticCanvasSize
properties.doc: Grows the canvas on X, Y or both to fit the children.

properties.name: ScrollingDirection
properties.doc: The axes the mouse wheel and drags scroll.

properties.name: ScrollingEnabled
properties.doc: When false, input does not scroll the canvas.

properties.name: ScrollBarThickness
properties.doc: The scroll bar's width in pixels.

properties.name: ScrollBarImageColor3
properties.doc: The scroll bar's colour.

properties.name: ScrollBarImageTransparency
properties.doc: How see-through the scroll bar is.

properties.name: AbsoluteCanvasSize
properties.doc: The canvas size in pixels, written each frame.

properties.name: AbsoluteWindowSize
properties.doc: The visible area in pixels, written each frame.

properties.name: ClipsDescendants
properties.doc: Scrolling frames clip their canvas.

classes.name: ViewportFrame
classes.note: Not drawn: ViewportFrame is a non-goal in M2.
classes.doc: A frame that draws 3D objects.

classes.name: UIBase
classes.doc: What every UI modifier has.

classes.name: UIComponent
classes.doc: A modifier of its parent element.

classes.name: UIConstraint
classes.doc: A limit on its parent's size.

classes.name: UILayout
classes.doc: Places its siblings, replacing their Position.

classes.name: UIGridStyleLayout
classes.doc: What list and grid layouts share.

properties.name: HorizontalAlignment
properties.doc: Where the elements sit horizontally in the parent.

properties.name: VerticalAlignment
properties.doc: Where the elements sit vertically in the parent.

properties.name: SortOrder
properties.doc: The order elements are placed in: LayoutOrder or Name (ties keep child order).

properties.name: AbsoluteContentSize
properties.doc: The size in pixels of the placed elements, written each frame.

classes.name: UIListLayout
classes.doc: Places its siblings one after another.

properties.name: FillDirection
properties.doc: The axis elements are placed along.

properties.name: Padding
properties.doc: The gap between elements: a fraction of the parent's size along the fill axis plus pixels.

properties.name: Wraps
properties.note: Stored only: lists do not wrap.
properties.doc: Stored only.

classes.name: UIGridLayout
classes.doc: Places its siblings in a grid of equal cells.

properties.name: FillDirection
properties.doc: The axis cells fill first.

properties.name: CellSize
properties.doc: The size of each cell: a fraction of the parent's size plus pixels.

properties.name: CellPadding
properties.doc: The gap between cells.

properties.name: FillDirectionMaxCells
properties.doc: The most cells along the fill direction; 0 fits as many as the parent holds.

properties.name: StartCorner
properties.doc: The corner the first cell is in.

properties.name: AbsoluteCellSize
properties.doc: The cell size in pixels, written each frame.

properties.name: AbsoluteCellCount
properties.doc: Columns and rows, written each frame.

classes.name: UIPadding
classes.doc: Insets the area its parent's children are placed in.

properties.name: PaddingTop
properties.doc: Space at the top: a fraction of the parent's height plus pixels.

properties.name: PaddingBottom
properties.doc: Space at the bottom.

properties.name: PaddingLeft
properties.doc: Space at the left: a fraction of the parent's width plus pixels.

properties.name: PaddingRight
properties.doc: Space at the right.

classes.name: UISizeConstraint
classes.doc: Keeps its parent's size between a minimum and a maximum in pixels.

properties.name: MinSize
properties.doc: The smallest size in pixels.

properties.name: MaxSize
properties.doc: The largest size in pixels.

classes.name: UIAspectRatioConstraint
classes.doc: Keeps its parent's width to height ratio.

properties.name: AspectRatio
properties.doc: Width divided by height.

properties.name: AspectType
properties.doc: FitWithinMaxSize shrinks the element to fit the size it would have; ScaleWithParentSize keeps the dominant axis and sets the other.

properties.name: DominantAxis
properties.doc: The axis kept by ScaleWithParentSize.

classes.name: UIScale
classes.doc: Scales its parent and its descendants.

properties.name: Scale
properties.doc: The factor, about the parent's anchor point.

classes.name: UICorner
classes.doc: Rounds its parent's corners.

properties.name: CornerRadius
properties.doc: The radius: a fraction of the shorter side plus pixels.

classes.name: UIStroke
classes.doc: Outlines its parent: its border, or its text for text elements.

properties.name: Color
properties.doc: The outline colour.

properties.name: Thickness
properties.doc: The outline width in pixels.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.doc: How see-through the outline is.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false, no outline is drawn.

properties.name: ApplyStrokeMode
properties.doc: Contextual outlines the text of text elements and the border of others; Border always outlines the border.

properties.name: LineJoinMode
properties.doc: How corners join.

classes.name: UIGradient
classes.note: Applied to backgrounds only, not to text or images.
classes.doc: Blends colours and transparency across its parent's background.

properties.name: Color
properties.doc: The colours across the element, multiplied into its background.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.doc: Transparency across the element, combined with the background's.

properties.name: Offset
properties.doc: Shifts the gradient, as a fraction of the element's size.

properties.name: Rotation
properties.doc: Turns the gradient clockwise, in degrees.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false, the gradient is not applied.
